cores.textbox: When this defends, **clash** with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Vigor token.

faces.printed_rules_text: When this defends, **clash** with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Vigor token. _(Clashing heroes reveal the top card of their deck. The hero that reveals the card with greatest {p} wins.)_
rules_text_html: When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner creates a Vigor token. (Clashing heroes reveal the top card of their deck. The hero that reveals the card with greatest wins.)

product.description:
The smell hits you first. Blood… Sweat… Steel…

Feral crowds roar loud as the thumping in your chest. You step into the arena, hot sand billowing at your feet. Drinks are poured, wagers are made, weapons are drawn…

Gold and glory is yours for the taking… If you survive the Deathmatch Arena!

faces.printed_rules_text: Quand cette carte défend, combattez en **duel** avec le héros attaquant. Le gagnant crée un jeton Vigueur. _(Les héros qui combattent en duel révèlent la première carte du dessus de leur deck. Le héros qui révèle la carte qui a la plus grande {p} gagne.)_

faces.printed_rules_text: Quando difende, **scontrati** con l'eroe attaccante. Il vincitore crea una pedina Vigore. _(Gli eroi che si scontrano rivelano la prima carta del proprio mazzo. Vince l'eroe che rivela la carta con {p} più elevata.)_
